sections.side_effects:

fullContent:
Phalkalyan Ghrita 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Yonivyapad Chikitsa 67/78-84 
 Phalkalyan Ghrita is an Ayurvedic medicine, in herbal ghee form. This medicine has ghee as its base. It is used in Ayurvedic treatment of male and female infertility. It balances the vata, pitta and kapha doshas in body. 
 Ingredients 
 12 grams of each of:- 
 
 Manjishta – Rubia cordifolia 
 Madhuka – Licorice – Glycyrrhiza glabra 
 Kushtha – Saussurea lappa 
 Triphala – Terminalia chebula, Terminalia bellirica, Phyllanthus emblica 
 Sharkara – Sugar 
 Bala – Sida retusa 
 Meja – Sida cordifolia 
 Payasya, Kakoli – Fritillaria roylei 
 Ashvagandha – Withania somnifera 
 Ajamoda – Carum roxburghianum 
 Haridra – Turmeric – Curcuma longa 
 Daruharidra – Berberis aristata 
 Hingu – Asa foetida 
 Katukarohini – Picrorhiza kurroa 
 Utpala – Nymphaea caerulea 
 Kumuda – Nymphaea stellata 
 Draksha – Raisin 
 Kakoli – Fritillaria roylei 
 Shvetachandana – Santalum album 
 Raktachandana – Pterocarpus santalinus 
 Ghrita – Ghee – 768 g 
 Shatavari juice – Asparagus racemosus  – 3.072 liters 
 Ksheera – cow milk – 3.072 liters 
 Lakshmanamoola – Ipomoea sepiaria 
 
 Dosage 
 Take quarter to half teaspoon with water, usually before food, once or twice a day, or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Benefits 
 
 Helps in successful conception. 
 Improves the intelligence and immunity in the fetus. 
 Given to women with habitual abortion for stable conception. 
 Helpful in relieving all types of gynecological complaints like defects in ovary and male reproductive system. 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 There are no known side effects with this medicine. Still it is best to use this product under medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine is discouraged. 
 High dosage may cause diarrhea and indigestion. 
 People with diabetes, high cholesterol, heart diseases and high BP should exercise precaution. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
